_doc: Presets de style. Ajoute le tien : positive = préfixe du prompt, negative, denoise = force de transformation (0.3 fidèle -> 0.7 très stylisé).

pixel_dark.positive: pixel art, 16-bit JRPG sprite, dark fantasy, clean 1px outlines, limited color palette, flat cel shading, game asset, single character, centered, plain flat gray background
pixel_dark.negative: blurry, smooth gradients, photo, realistic, 3d render, text, watermark, signature, extra limbs, cropped, background scenery, multiple characters, noise

anime_cel.positive: anime game sprite, cel shading, bold clean outlines, vibrant colors, dramatic lighting, game asset, single character, centered, plain flat gray background
anime_cel.negative: blurry, photo, realistic, 3d render, text, watermark, signature, extra limbs, cropped, background scenery, multiple characters

painted_hd.positive: 2D hand-painted game sprite, detailed brush strokes, soft rim lighting, rich colors, game asset, single character, centered, plain flat gray background
painted_hd.negative: blurry, photo, 3d render, text, watermark, signature, extra limbs, cropped, background scenery, multiple characters
